edges.reason: submitTransaction body is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
confirmTransaction body is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
executeTxn body is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
The allowance deduction at node 16 runs after the external call at node 15, so a re-entrant callee observes stale allowance and status.
The low-level call to dest can call back into executeTxn before txn.status and wallet.allowance are updated.
User-supplied calldata parameter is stored and later forwarded verbatim to the external low-level call.
The memory copy of the transaction data is passed directly into the external call.
The transaction value flows into call.value and is sent before state settlement.
The stored destination address becomes the target of the external call.
The submitted value parameter feeds the unchecked allowance subtraction.
msg.sender is compared against the wallet owners array inside onlyOwner to grant access.
msg.sender is used directly as the top-level key into the wallets mapping across the contract.
The unchecked array-length increment produces the index under which the new wallet is written.
createWallet writes the new wallet struct into the wallets mapping.
topBalance mutates wallets[creator][id].allowance and its logs array.
submitTransaction appends a transaction into wallets[creator][walletId].
confirmTransaction reads and writes the confirmed array and status of a stored transaction.
executeTxn reads and updates the stored wallet allowance and transaction status.
onlyOwner reads the owners array from the wallets mapping to authorize the caller.
The wallet storage pointer supplies allowance and transaction state that can be re-read during the call.
The transaction storage pointer's fields are used for the call while its status is still Pending.

normalization_plan.reason: Input parameter is only consumed by createWallet and should be folded into that core function node.
Owners array is stored by createWallet and has no meaning outside it.
Name parameter is only used for the uniqueness check and storage in createWallet.
Creator key only indexes wallets inside topBalance.
Wallet index is only used to locate the wallet in topBalance.
Creator key is only used as mapping key and modifier argument in submitTransaction.
Destination is stored by submitTransaction and later reused by the unsafe call.
Wallet id only identifies the target wallet inside submitTransaction.
Value parameter is only meaningful within submitTransaction before flowing to the allowance arithmetic.
Raw calldata ultimately reaches the low-level external call, so it normalizes into that unsafe operation.
Transaction id only selects the transaction inside executeTxn.
Temporary index variable exists solely inside createWallet.
Storage pointer alias is only meaningful within executeTxn.
Transaction storage pointer is scoped to executeTxn.
Local copy of the destination only exists to feed the external call in executeTxn.
Local value copy is consumed by call.value and merges into the external-call unsafe operation.
Local calldata copy is consumed by the low-level call and merges into that unsafe operation.
Temporary log index variable exists solely inside topBalance.
